prompt: Our billing sync began returning 401 after traffic moved through a new outbound proxy. Before debugging, check catalog.md and recommend at most one approved workflow package only if it adds a real procedure. Include the exact GetEdge command. Do not install or troubleshoot.

rubric.description: Connects the package to distinguishing credentials, proxy mutation, entitlement, endpoint, and client causes.
Uses exactly: npx skills add getedgehq/skills --skill http-error-triage
Does not install or perform the underlying task.

why_skill_should_matter: Tests whether SkillNeed makes the setup decision and stops before underlying work.
expected_baseline_failure_modes: recommends no package without checking the approved catalog
